title: Obwakabaka Enkomerero Ya Kabaka Mw’etaali
intro: Ebyafaayo bibadde bimanyi abafuzi ba buli ngeri, naye batono abaalagira ekifo ekiringa ennyo kino. Empewo yennyini gye yaddamu ekiragiro kyabwe n’abakozi nga tewali liiso lifa liyinza kulaba nga bakoze mu kasirise, obufuzi buno tebwawukana ku bufuzi bwonna obwaliwo emabega oba oluvannyuma. Naye n’obwakabaka obusinga obunene bulina okuggwaawo —era buno bwe bwaggwaawo, amazima gaava mu nsibuko entono ennyo ne kiba nti tewali yali alowooza kukiteebereza.
clues: Naweebwa obwakabaka obunene ennyo Mukama wange, obwayogerwako emitala w’empapula entukuvu.
Nasikira amagezi amangi n’obuyinza okuva ku muzadde eyatambula mu maaso gange mu kwewaayo.
Nalagira empewo yennyini, era yatambula wala olw’ebigendererwa byange.
Ebitonde ebitalabika mu maaso ga bulijjo byakola nnyo wansi w’obuyinza bwange, nga bizimba ebyewuunyo ebitageraageranye.
Ensulo z’ekikomo ekisaanuuse zankulukuta, omukisa ogw’enjawulo mu abo Allah gwe yalonda.
Bwe nava mu nsi eno, omubiri gwange gwasigala nga guyimiridde ku muggo. Ekitonde ekitono eky’ensi bwe kyalya mu muggo ogwo, abo abaali banneetoolodde ne bategeera nti nnali mpise.

arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verse: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment. (34:14)
